opening.label: Flat to marginally mixed start
opening.headline: Flat to marginally mixed start: Wall Street weak, Asia positive, crude easing
drivers: GIFT Nifty 25,224.5 (-3 pts, -0.01% vs Nifty's last close).
Asia this morning: Nikkei +0.28%, Hang Seng -0.91%, Kospi +1.99%.
Currency, crude and volatility: Brent 89.46 (-3.95%); USD/INR 93.440 (-0.56%); India VIX 15.52 (+0.00%).

story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,323, a gap-down of 0.25% from the previous close of 25,387.
The index dipped to a low of 25,142 (-0.97%) around 1:05 PM and touched a high of 25,391 (+0.01%) around 9:15 AM.
It settled at 25,228 (-0.63%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
15 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 34 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (-0.38%).
Latest institutional data (16 Nov): FII/FPI net +4865 Cr, DII net -3519 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,340.53 (-1.03%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$89.46 (-3.95%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 93.440 (-0.56%), US 10-year yield 5.10% (-0.35%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,224.5 (-0.01% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
